points.quote: `workbench.web.main.ts` adds the web-specific ones, such as the web worker extension host and browser-based file and storage services.
`workbench.common.main.ts` imports the contributions and services both builds share.
Services are registered with `registerSingleton`, and each build supplies its own implementation of the platform-specific ones.
The bundler only includes files reachable from the entry it builds. A feature that is never imported from an entry isn't loaded at all.
Contributions under `workbench/contrib/<feature>/` register themselves through side-effect imports, such as `import './contrib/foo/browser/foo.contribution.js'`.
